title: OCR receipts straight into a spreadsheet
description: Scan receipts, extract line items with OCR, and log them to Google Sheets automatically.
overview: A pipeline that scans photographed receipts, extracts line items and totals with OCR, and appends the structured data to a Google Sheet automatically.
prerequisites: A Google Cloud project with the Sheets API enabled
An OCR provider API key, such as Google Vision or a dedicated receipt-OCR API
A service account with edit access to the target spreadsheet

steps.title: Capture the receipt
steps.content: Upload a photo through a simple form or a mobile shortcut that posts the image to your automation's ingest endpoint.

steps.title: Run OCR extraction
steps.content: Send the image to the OCR provider and request structured fields rather than raw text where the API supports it.

code.code:
const result = await ocrClient.extractReceipt(imageBuffer);
// result: { merchant, date, items: [{ name, price }], total }

steps.title: Normalize the data
steps.content: Clean up currency formatting and merge near-duplicate line items before writing anything to the sheet.

steps.title: Append to Google Sheets
steps.content: Use the Sheets API to append one row per line item, tagged with the receipt's merchant and date.

steps.title: Flag low-confidence scans
steps.content: If the OCR provider returns a confidence score below your threshold, route the receipt to a manual review queue instead of writing bad data into the sheet.

architecture: Images flow through a single ingest endpoint into the OCR provider, then through a normalization step before touching the spreadsheet. Keeping normalization separate from extraction makes it easy to swap OCR providers later without changing how data lands in Sheets.
result: Receipts logged as clean, itemized rows in Google Sheets within seconds of being photographed, with no manual data entry.

troubleshooting.issue: OCR returns garbled or empty text
troubleshooting.cause: The photo is low-resolution, poorly lit, or the receipt was captured at a steep angle.
troubleshooting.fix: Add basic image preprocessing such as cropping and deskewing before sending to the OCR provider, or prompt the user to retake the photo.

troubleshooting.issue: Sheets API call fails with a 403
troubleshooting.cause: The service account was never given edit access to the specific spreadsheet.
troubleshooting.fix: Share the spreadsheet with the service account's email address as an Editor.

troubleshooting.issue: Line item totals don't match the receipt total
troubleshooting.cause: OCR occasionally splits one line item into two separate rows.
troubleshooting.fix: Add a validation step that sums extracted line items and flags the receipt for manual review if it doesn't match the extracted total.
